vetSays.line: 🛡️ Javier, Dallan, Chloe and Rosa met them at the door — 4 put down. Javier, Dallan, Chloe, Rosa are hurt.
🛡️ Javier, Seymour, Chloe and Rosa met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Javier, Seymour are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Javier, Chloe, Thabo and Zoltan met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Javier, Chloe, Thabo, Zoltan are hurt.
🛡️ Javier, Chloe, Rosa, Thabo and Zoltan met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Rosa didn't come back. Javier, Chloe, Thabo, Zoltan are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chloe just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Zoltan just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Javier, Chloe, Thabo, Zoltan and Hannah met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Javier, Chloe, Zoltan, Hannah are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
🛡️ Javier, Thabo, Zoltan, Hannah and Vicente met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Javier, Zoltan, Hannah, Vicente are hurt.
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Thabo just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
◈ THE WAR PATH — The System pauses — actually pausing. It keeps a list of every tooth pulled, and for once it reads the list instead of the press release. On day 82, Oliver put down Big Loud.

"THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced Ugly-Eyes and lived to sit here. They faced The Big Beast and lived to sit here. 1 more of the later drafts faced besides. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: put weapons in hands (5 of 6 armed); blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.

log: Tama saw The Strike in time and gave it room.
